I will plant maize with my intercrop on this plot and depend mostly on the rains, because here in Mangochi we normally farm in the rainy season and I do not have irrigation. If I can get subsidized inputs, I will use a small amount of chemical fertilizer and improved seed, but I will not spend money on pesticides. I will also use whatever manure or compost I can gather, and most of the work will be done by my family, with only a few hired labor days when work is heavy.
